description: Returns status and result of a CloneMotion video generation job. Use when the user wants to check if a generated video is ready or view it. Job IDs come from generate_video_clip. A finished video plays in the card. Generation can take a few minutes; if status is pending or running, ask the user to check again after waiting.

job_id.description: Video job ID returned by generate_video_clip.

name: get_video_generation_status
title: Get video generation status
